items.title: 67395_Vic Dickenson oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Clara. [INTERVIEWER] Clara, yeah. Just a gang of them. They were not related.

ctx.x: I don't know really. But I listened to the words of the Blues then. It was Mamie Smith I used to listen to, and Bessie Smith...and Trixie Smith, yeah... And there were some other Smiths then, too. There was a lot of Smiths...
Clara, yeah. Just a gang of them.
